title: Fix Forms Plugin SDK Imports
description: forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs (around lines 882-907) imports ProtocolBuilderConfig, PROTOCOL_BUILDER_LABELS_EN, render_protocol_builder, BlockPaletteEntry from semio_framework_plugin, but these symbols moved to the protocol crate as part of ticket #2033's SDK extraction. This leaves forms/plugin currently NOT compiling, blocking other concurrent work on the plugin SDK. Task: mirror the identical mechanical swap already applied in procedural/plugin/rs/lib.rs and flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs — add a dependency on the protocol crate to forms/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml (matching procedural/flow's style), fix the imports in forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs to pull from protocol instead of semio_framework_plugin, then run cargo check -p <forms plugin package name> and cargo test -p <same> until clean. Scope strictly limited to forms/plugin/rs/ and its Cargo.toml.
